question: Who among the following was appointed as the Chairman of Telecom Equipment and Services Export Promotion Council (TEPC) in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sandeep Aggarwal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sandeep Aggarwal:**

 
 
• **He has been appointed as the new Chairman of the Telecom Equipment and Services Export Promotion Council (TEPC). Hence, Option 1 is correct.**
 
• He is the **MD of Paramount Communications Ltd., a cable manufacturer**.
 
• He will take over from **Shyamal Ghosh**, **ex-Telecom Secretary.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Telecom Equipment and Services Export Promotion Council (TEPC)**

 
 
• **It has been set up by the Government of India to promote and develop the export of Telecom Equipment and Services.**
 
• **TEPC **as a Council plays a critical role in the furtherance of Telecom export from India and assists Indian member companies in easy facilitation of their respective exports.
 
• The **Council caters to the complete Telecom Ecosystem **including **Telecom Hardware Manufacturing, Telecom Service Provision, Telecom Software, and Consultancy.**
 
• It thus represents the strength of **Equipment Manufacturers, System Integrators, Service Providers, and other stakeholders in the telecom domain**.
